{{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} [[File:Pokémon hunters JN053.png|thumb|250px|The Pokémon hunters]] The '''Pokémon hunters''' (Japanese: '''ポケモンハンター''' ''Pokémon hunters'') are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN053|Healing the Healer!]]''. They capture {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} for their boss. ==In animation== ===History=== They first had their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} poison a lake in order to lure out a {{TP|Goh|Suicune}}. {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] encountered the Pokémon hunters and tried to stop them when Suicune appeared. The hunters had their Pokémon attack Suicune, injuring and {{status|poisoned|poisoning}} it. They tied it up, only for Goh to throw a {{i|Poké Ball}} at Suicune, allowing him to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} it. Goh proceeded to run away with Suicune as the hunters battled Ash. After overcoming Ash, the hunters continued their search for Goh and Suicune and soon found them. They were able to catch Suicune, only for it to break free from their net and freeze them, allowing them to be arrested by [[Officer Jenny]]. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} ====Boss==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pokémon hunters |pkmn=Houndoom |type1=Dark |type2=Fire |img=Pokémon hunter Houndoom.png |epnum=JN053 |epname=Healing the Healer! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Houndoom}} is the boss's only known Pokémon. He sent it out to battle [[Goh]], after his newly caught {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Drowzee}} was causing trouble and was able to defeat it. Houndoom battled {{TP|Goh|Suicune}}, only to be defeated by the Legendary Pokémon. Houndoom's only known moves are {{m|Crunch}} and {{m|Flamethrower}}.}} ====Hunters==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Pokémon hunters |pkmn=Garbodor |type1=Poison |img=Pokémon hunter Garbodor.png |epnum=JN053 |epname=Healing the Healer! |vajp= |vaen=Erica Schroeder |desc={{p|Garbodor}} was among the Pokémon used by the hunters to poison a lake in an attempt to draw the attention of {{TP|Goh|Suicune}}.
